## Change and evidence

Describe what is implemented, what was executed, and what remains source-level or proposed.

## Human publication review

- [ ] All content is newly authored or explicitly authorized for public reuse.
- [ ] No corporate data, private artifacts, configured reports or private history is present.
- [ ] Synthetic demo and offline tests reproduce; engine-specific claims match actual evidence.
- [ ] AI development assistance is distinct from runtime AI; scale claims have approved evidence.
- [ ] The full diff and file manifest were reviewed.
- [ ] Auto-merge remains disabled. A human will decide whether to merge.
